title.zh: Coinbase 将在欧盟下架多种稳定币
title.en: Coinbase to delist multiple stablecoins in EU b...

current_state.zh:
据报道，Coinbase 计划面向欧盟用户下架多种稳定币，其中包括 Tether 的 USDT 和 MakerDAO 的 DAI，相关变更提及 10 月 30 日这一截止日期。

若该措施落实，欧盟地区的 Coinbase 用户将无法在该交易所交易或持有这些稳定币，从而缩小当地可用的稳定币范围，并推动用户转向符合欧盟要求的替代品。

据报道被下架的品种包括 USDT 与 DAI；据 CoinDesk，USDT 是规模最大的稳定币，流通量超过 1870 亿美元，约占全球稳定币市场的 64%。
current_state.en: Coinbase is set to delist several stablecoins, including USDT and DAI, for users in the EU by an October 30 deadline, tightening which stable assets remain tradable in the region.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Coinbase is set to delist several stablecoins, including USDT and DAI, for users in the EU by an October 30 deadline, tightening which stable assets remain tradable in the region.
updates.background_zh: 此举被置于欧盟《加密资产市场条例》（MiCA）的背景下：MiCA 要求在欧洲经济区（EEA）运营的稳定币发行方遵守牌照许可程序，并将稳定币划为单独的高风险类别（资产参考型代币与电子货币代币）。针对 EEA 发行方的 MiCA 许可制度自 2024 年 6 月 30 日起适用。
updates.background_en: The move is reported against the backdrop of the EU's Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA), which requires stablecoin issuers operating in the European Economic Area to comply with licensing procedures and classifies stablecoins as a distinct, higher-risk category (asset-referenced and e-money tokens). That MiCA licensing regime for EEA issuers has applied since June 30, 2024.
updates.market_impact_zh: 其传导渠道主要是司法辖区的准入，而非资产层面的供给：面向欧盟的 Coinbase 订单簿、交易对与出入金流量将转向符合 MiCA 电子货币代币或资产参考型代币要求的稳定币；就单一交易所在欧盟的下架而言，USDT 约 1870 亿美元的全球流通量本身不受直接改变。
updates.market_impact_en: The channel is jurisdictional access rather than asset-level supply: EU-facing Coinbase order books, trading pairs and on/off-ramp flows would rotate toward stablecoins that meet MiCA's e-money or asset-referenced token requirements, while a single venue's EU delisting leaves USDT's roughly $187 billion global circulation unchanged in itself.
